clips.title: The story
paras: Lake Al'Ameth is one of the largest freshwater bodies nestled high in the boughs of Teldrassil, located just south of Dolanaar. Though once a tranquil haven featuring little more than a simple wooden jetty, its shores have grown perilous due to the violent agitation of the local plant life.

Resting immediately south of the village of Dolanaar, Lake Al'Ameth serves as a vital natural basin in the heart of Teldrassil. Despite its serene waters and minimal settlement, peace here has evaporated. Swarms of agitated timberlings and timberling sprouts prowl the water's edge, driven mad by an unnatural sickness spreading through the world tree. Druids and researchers from Dolanaar frequently dispatch travelers to these shores to gather seeds and cull the aggressive creatures before the corruption spreads deeper into the surrounding forest.
